ruleset_name: ANI Nueva Ecija Rainfed Planting Window Rules

effective_rainfall_rule.note: Do not substitute forecast rainfall total. Calibrate from effective rainfall/crop-water balance.

soil_water_rule.note: Must be soil-series/local-field specific; do not use a universal volumetric-water cutoff.

temperature_rule.note: Use expert-reviewed planting/establishment thresholds, not merely broad physiological cardinal temperatures.

wind_rule.note: Calibrate to establishment method, crop stage, and local expert guidance.

references.use: Nueva Ecija soil-series properties and rice management constraints
Direct-seeded rice establishment differs with soil-moisture condition
